```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
```

```{r loading mapping stat files}
DOX_ChIP_samplenames <- read_delim("C:/Users/renee/Other_projects_data/DOX_CHIP/DOX_ChIP_samplenames.txt", 
    delim = "\t", escape_double = FALSE, 
    trim_ws = TRUE)
set1_parsed <- read_delim("C:/Users/renee/Other_projects_data/DOX_CHIP/mapping_stats/set1_parsed.tsv", 
    delim = "\t", escape_double = FALSE, 
    trim_ws = TRUE)
set2_parsed <- read_delim("C:/Users/renee/Other_projects_data/DOX_CHIP/mapping_stats/set2_parsed.tsv", 
    delim = "\t", escape_double = FALSE, 
    trim_ws = TRUE)
set3_parsed <- read_delim("C:/Users/renee/Other_projects_data/DOX_CHIP/mapping_stats/set3_parsed.tsv", 
    delim = "\t", escape_double = FALSE, 
    trim_ws = TRUE)


Mapping_stats_combo <-
set1_parsed %>% 
  bind_rows(.,set2_parsed) %>%  
  bind_rows(.,set3_parsed) %>% 
  left_join(., DOX_ChIP_samplenames, by =c("sample_name"="Sample name")) %>% 
  mutate(total_reads=total_reads*2)

my_colors=c(CTCF="blue",RAD21="purple",TOP2B="red",p53="violet",Input_P53="pink")
pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.75)
```

```{r}

Mapping_stats_combo %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=sample_name, y=alignment_rate)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill=Ab))+
  theme_bw()+
  scale_fill_manual(values=my_colors)+
  ggtitle("Alignment rate by sample")+
theme(axis.text.x=element_text(vjust= .2,angle=90))

Mapping_stats_combo %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=Individual, y=alignment_rate)) +
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_point(aes(color=Ab, size=3))+
  theme_bw()+
  facet_wrap(~Tx)+
  scale_color_manual(values=my_colors)+
  ggtitle("Alignment rate by individual")
   
Mapping_stats_combo %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=Tx, y=alignment_rate)) +
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_point(aes(color=Individual, size=3))+
  theme_bw()+
  facet_wrap(~Ab)+
  ggtitle("Alignment for each individual by treatment")


```
```{r}
Mapping_stats_combo %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=sample_name, y=concord_1_pct)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill=Ab))+
  theme_bw()+
  scale_fill_manual(values=my_colors)+
  ggtitle("Percent concordantly mapping 1 time by sample")+
theme(axis.text.x=element_text(vjust= .2,angle=90))


Mapping_stats_combo %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=Individual, y=concord_1_pct)) +
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_point(aes(color=Ab, size=3))+
  theme_bw()+
  facet_wrap(~Tx)+
  scale_color_manual(values=my_colors)+
  ggtitle("Percent concordantly mapping 1 time by individual")
   
Mapping_stats_combo %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=Tx, y=concord_1_pct)) +
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_point(aes(color=Individual, size=3))+
  theme_bw()+
  facet_wrap(~Ab)+
  ggtitle("Percent concordantly mapping 1 time each individual\nby treatment")
```
